title: Autonomous Credit Risk Scoring System & MLOps Pipeline
summary: An end-to-end MLOps pipeline for Indonesian banking credit-risk scoring that generates synthetic training data, applies WoE feature selection and SMOTE class-balancing, trains an XGBoost model, and validates synthetic data via a TSTR/TRTR quality gate; its TSTR methodology documentation cites CTGANSynthesizer as an example synthesizer, but no actual SDV import or call site is evidenced.
evidence: TSTR/TSTR_Methodology.md:7 — 'The dataset generated by a synthesizer (e.g., CTGANSynthesizer or VGM).'
needs: No code evidence of an actual sdv import/call; GenerateData.py (the real synthetic generator) is not shown to use SDV, so this may be a mention-only reference rather than an active dependency.
